sheets.finding: All24 northern airfield/cargo/approach/ring cells inspected. Runway/taxiway markings and physical widths, apron equipment/occupancy, roof details, commercial car-lot density and ring vegetation remain visibly simplified. Exact source bodies/ways are retained; low measured/inferred tree coverage outside mapped sample extents remains visible. Generic roofs, surface materials and roadway/parcel terrain are not real-world parity. The4 representative measured aircraft do not represent all reference aircraft or a current fleet.

All12 taxiway/cargo/highway/low-rise cells inspected. Source footprint and street arrangement remain; commercial rooftop equipment/material, physical taxiway width/marking, vehicle-lot occupancy, residential roofs/facades and measured crown/species detail remain simplified. Sparse vegetation outside measured coverage and the exact600m source boundary are visible. Roof projection under the perspective250m atlas differs from a ground-orthographic reference; no unsupported dimensions are inferred.

All12 residential, taxiway, apron-edge, car-lot and approach cells inspected. Dense measured crowns and source footprints remain; species/height/canopy model, estimated residential roof geometry, parking occupancy, rooftop detail, taxiway widths/markings and ground/embankment terrain differ. Source roof attributes retain independent provenance and OSM priority; no blanket parity claim.

Generic source roofs/materials and parking layout/occupancy remain; the northern apron and taxiway surface/marking and airport support detail remain simplified. Reference acquisition date, real absolute terrain/road elevations and unsupported height/detail remain unknown. Measured crowns cover the independently surveyed region, with sparse outside detail explicitly visible.
